officialSources.observation: Official Xiamen Natural Resources and Planning Bureau organizational page identifies the natural-resources survey/monitoring and rights-registration office and the surveying/information office; this is local institutional custody evidence, not an open parcel API.

Official iXiamen service listing identifies the Xiamen Surveying and Basic Geographic Information Center online hall and states that it provides cadastral maps, parcel maps, and basic surveying-result query/use services.

Official Xiamen property-registration portal states that users are managed through unified authentication and real-name verification; the public page did not expose an anonymous parcel geometry service.
Official Jimei government document names 灌口镇人民政府 in a land-acquisition procedure, supporting the locality match but not parcel geometry or cadastral API availability.
